thesis: The podcast argues that despite being deeply embedded and highly defensible, enterprise platforms like Workday face a crisis because their user experiences remain broken and unloved by employees. It posits that AI offers a unique opportunity to fundamentally rethink and rebuild these core systems, creating a race between incumbents who must pivot and new insurgents who can replace entrenched solutions.
